sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.
The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus restraining the respondents from raising constructions over the land of the petitioner till payment of adequate compensation.

The petitioner has also prayed for a writ of mandamus restraining the respondents from compelling him to execute the sale-deed of Plot No. 1086 in their favour.
2.

The case of the petitioner is that the respondents are compelling the petitioner to execute sale-deed in respect of his aforesaid land at the rate of Rs.8,600.00 per square meter for widening of Buddha Circuit which the petitioner is not ready to execute as the sale consideration being offered to him is not as per market value.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned State counsel has placed on record the written instructions received from the State-respondents.
According to it, the respondents have notified the subject land for acquisition under the provisions of the new Act i.e. Act No. 30 of 2013.
The date of notification under Section 19 of the Act is 05.11.2024.
It is stated that soon an award would be declared and the petitioner would be paid compensation strictly in accordance with the provisions of the Act.

4. In view of the said subsequent development, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the respondents would pay compensation to the petitioner strictly in accordance with the provisions of Act No. 30 of 2013 and shall also take possession strictly in accordance with the provisions of the said Act.

Order Date :- 9.12.2024 Mukesh Kr.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
